A quiet studio that does not ask you to push. If you feel stiff, or if exercise has never been your thing, you can still start.
An hour away from the rest of the day, with room to notice your breath and your body.
Stiff is fine. New to exercise is fine.
Mats and clothes can be borrowed
Classes for different aims, and for people at different stages.
Replace this photo from Edit layout at the top left. Drop a photo on this frame, and edit the text there too. Photo idea: a fundamentals class, something like mountain pose or downward dog.
Slow poses, and time to learn how to use your body. A good first class.

One breath, one movement. A steadier, more rhythmic class.
